data.one_liner: Flutter layout for docking widgets into split and tabbed views.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of widgets to arrange child widgets in docking areas that can be split horizontally or vertically and grouped into tabbed panels. Supports saving and loading the layout state as a string.
use_when: You need a dynamic workspace with resizable split panes and tabbed sections, like IDEs or dashboards.
You want to let users rearrange panels at runtime via drag‑and‑drop.
avoid_when: The UI is static and does not require runtime rearrangement.
You prefer a lightweight layout without additional dependencies.
strengths: Flexible split‑view and tabbed docking system
weaknesses: Relies on the external tabbed_view package, which may cause compatibility issues
Documentation is limited to a demo site

alternatives.name: assorted_layout_widgets
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a collection of layout widgets (grids, stacks, etc.) that can replace basic docking needs without extra dependencies.
